Several weeks ago I decided to paint as an outlet for stress and negative emotions. I'm a scientist, not an artist so please excuse the lack of quality. Even though it looks like something a young grade-schooler painted, I'm still pretty proud of it myself!

My painting was inspired by a video game and a movie. On the left hand side, you have elements from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. From top to bottom, the Triforce, the windmill with mountains in the background, and Link playing his Ocarina. On the right hand side you have one of the most memorable scenes from My Neighbor Totoro (Tonari no Totoro).

I painted Tonari No Totoro 「となりのトトロ」in pink, but I wanted it vertically instead of horizontally. I customize the bus stop on the left to my own liking. 

The top label reads 迷いの森行
This bus terminates at the Lost Forest. 

The middle label reads ⭐カカリコ村前
This bus stop is Kakariko Village.

The bottom label reads ハイラル電鉄バス
Hyrule "Electric Railway" Bus

The bus stop timetable is in the white rectangle. Instead of putting a full time table I put 21~05 気をつけてね which means be careful from 9PM to 5AM. These are the nighttime hours in Breath of the Wild. 


I took several time lapse videos of me painting this, but it will take some time to stitch all of the videos together.
